title: Omarchy Quattro Operating System Bridge & Domain-Partitioned Plugin Synthesis
summary: Synthesized bridge architecture connecting Brain Harness to Omarchy Quattro (v4.0.0.alpha), DHH's agentic Linux distribution. Partitions 1,826 files across 40 functional groups into three domain-specific plugins per Rule 18: (1) omarchy_command_router in developer_tooling introspecting 455+ modular CLI scripts via decentralized # omarchy:key=value header tags; (2) omarchy_theming_engine in developer_tooling providing full ANSI/semantic palette resolution, sed-compatible template rendering with linear RGB mixing and Hyprland gradients, and WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio auditing; (3) omarchy_agent_telemetry in agent_orchestration cataloging 9 developer guides and runtime agent skills with static AST telemetry analysis for non-Linux hosts.

references.description: Command router plugin, lazy in-memory cache, and metadata parser
Theming engine, palette resolver, template renderer, and WCAG auditor
